title: The finite forget-support Cartier arrow in normalized coefficient coordinates
statement: Let a be a normalized finite frame [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-supported-finite-boundary-frame], L a derived-limit model, and z a degree-two residue-coefficient Cartier class supported on the diagonal [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface]. Define a.cartierMap to be the actual coefficient projection k.unitMap(L) followed by L.projection(n), the source coordinates [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-supported-finite-boundary-unit-coordinates], the finite constant-to-diagonal-supported unit, the exact scalar-restriction image of z, and the inverse target coordinates [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-supported-finite-boundary-line-coordinates]. This fixes a morphism from the restricted completed unit to the evaluated restricted coefficient Tate line shifted by two.
